# Marketing consent: bottom line for the product team

Date: 2026-01-02.

Jurisdictions: EU.

Question: whether the product may rely on consent for the marketing flow.

Template: executive-brief.

The product team is launching a marketing flow for EU users. Consent works as the basis once the opt-in is unticked. Withdrawal has to be one click.

## 1. Consent as the basis of the flow

Consent is available for this flow [[src:gdpr-art-6 Art. 6(1)(a)]].

> [[q:q-gdpr-art-6-1]] Consent must be freely given, specific, informed and unambiguous.

The provision sets the quality bar, and a pre-ticked box would not meet it. The bar is met once the user acts affirmatively.

Risk: medium. The basis holds while the opt-in stays unticked. Product must keep it unticked before launch.

## 2. Recommendations

- Keep the opt-in unticked at launch, owned by Product, before the flow ships.
